Priya Nair: Quick heads-up — we start the sandbox program with 3 customers tomorrow morning. Main ask: CS to own weekly health checks and a single feedback rollup for Product. Link to tracking doc: https://redwood.app/sandbox-tracker
Ethan Cho: +1. I can take Acme + EdgeSoft. I'll run the first health check Wed morning PT.
Samira Patel: Agree on a lightweight survey. My draft (3 q's):
Samira Patel: ```
1) Value score 1-5
2) Was setup clear? (yes/no)
3) Anything blocked or surprising? (short free text)
```
Connor Lee: Can someone paste the participant CSV so I can wire up analytics?
Priya Nair: CSV below for ingestion: 
Priya Nair: ```
org,contact,timezone,ae_owner
Acme Inc,alice@acme.com,PT,James Park
EdgeSoft,devops@edgesoft.io,ET,Ethan Cho
Cinder Labs,ops@cinder.ai,CET,Lydia Ramos
```
OnboardBot: Added 3 participants to sandbox program and created calendar invites. Next check-in scheduled: 2026-04-01T17:00:00Z :white_check_mark:
Lydia Ramos: Heads-up — Cinder flagged SSO gaps during pre-check. We should triage with eng-infra before their first test.
James Park: Noted. If we see <10% feature usage after 2 weeks we'll escalate to AE renewal playbook.
Priya Nair: Action items: 
Priya Nair: - Ethan: run Acme & EdgeSoft weekly checks and post a short readout here
Priya Nair: - Lydia: triage Cinder SSO with eng-infra and update this thread
Priya Nair: - Samira: finalize survey and add it to the tracker doc + GH repo (small script to collect responses)
Ethan Cho: Got it. I'll post the first readout after Wed's check-in. :rocket:
Samira Patel: I'll wire the survey into the tracker and include a quick snippet to auto-summarize free-text.
Connor Lee: Once I get the CSV I'm going to add event hooks for token usage and prompt failure rates.
Priya Nair: Thanks all — I'll compile the weekly rollup every Friday and surface any high-priority regressions to Product. If anyone hears hard pushback from customers, ping me directly. :heart:
